headline: GPT-5.6 Sol enhancements and expanded access in ChatGPT

items.title: Improving GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT—and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol, enhancing accuracy and consistency in ChatGPT. Additionally, access to GPT-5.6 Luna has been expanded for free users, allowing unlimited everyday chats. These changes aim to enhance the user experience by providing more reliable and accessible AI interactions.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can leverage improved AI models for more accurate and consistent user interactions, enhancing application reliability.

items.title: LLM optimization integration for Amazon SageMaker Python SDK
items.summary: The Amazon SageMaker Python SDK v3 now includes generative AI inference recommendations directly in your notebook. Users can benchmark an endpoint, receive data-driven deployment recommendations, and deploy configurations without leaving the notebook workflow.

items.title: Build visibility for Codex on Amazon Bedrock with OpenTelemetry and Amazon CloudWatch
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports routing Codex OpenTelemetry metrics through a local collector to Amazon CloudWatch. This allows engineering teams to gain visibility into adoption, consumption, and reliability by user, team, and cost center.

items.title: GitHub Actions and Pages are experiencing degraded availability
items.summary: GitHub has reported degraded availability for its Actions and Pages services. This may affect workflows and deployments, requiring teams to monitor and adapt their CI/CD processes accordingly.

items.title: Agentic Nesting: A New Methodology for Existing Enterprise Application Integration and Services
items.summary: This research proposes 'Agentic Nesting', a methodology aimed at integrating enterprise applications to reduce data silos and process fragmentation. It offers a strategic framework for improving interoperability among business systems.

Securing AI agents with temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore let you define stateful rules that evaluate authorization based on an agent's session history. Learn how to enforce workflow sequencing, prevent data fabrication, cap financial exposure, and require human approval for high-value actions.

all_items.title: Configure rate limits for AI traffic on AgentCore gateway
all_items.summary: Learn how to configure rate limits on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway to enforce per-user and per-target traffic controls. Define request, token, and connection limits scoped by JWT claims or IAM identity to protect downstream models, tools, and agents from traffic spikes.

all_items.title: Control agent behaviors and cost beyond a single action: new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn about new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: temporal policies powered by Dogwood, a new open source policy language for AI agents, and rate limiting on the gateway. These features give you deterministic control over sequences of agent actions and cost ceilings that hold regardless of agent behavior.

all_items.title: Build visibility for Codex on Amazon Bedrock with OpenTelemetry and Amazon CloudWatch
all_items.summary: As engineering teams adopt coding agents like Codex, leaders need visibility into adoption, consumption, and reliability. This post shows how to route Codex OpenTelemetry metrics through a local collector to Amazon CloudWatch for an AWS native view of usage by user, team, and cost center.

all_items.title: Enforcing data residency with single-Region Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: A regulated customer needed all Claude Code inference processed in a single AWS Region (London), not just in-geography. This post shows two ways to pin Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock to one Region: an application inference profile or the Mantle endpoint, paired with an IAM Region condition, plus how to verify compliance in AWS CloudTrail.

all_items.title: Agent Skills for Automated Reasoning policies in Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: Learn how to run the full Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning policy lifecycle from your coding agent. A suite of open source Agent Skills builds, reviews, tests, debugs, deploys, and validates a custom policy end to end, turning a specialized console task into a repeatable engineering workflow.

all_items.title: Building an agentic app deployer with Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda
all_items.summary: PDI Technologies built PDI Brew, an agentic platform on AWS where non-technical employees describe a tool in plain English and receive a fully provisioned, multi-tenant web application in seconds. See how a pluggable planner and an AWS Lambda provisioning agent turn plain-English intent into governed, multi-tenant apps backed by Amazon Bedrock.

all_items.title: How LendingTree built a multi-agent mortgage assistant on Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: Learn how LendingTree built a production multi-agent mortgage assistant on Amazon Bedrock. Three coordinated agents use LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and Amazon Nova models with built-in guardrails to deliver 24/7 personalized mortgage guidance while meeting strict financial-services compliance.

all_items.title: How Mobileye transformed support operations using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: In this post, we'll explore how Mobileye deployed an AI support agentic solution on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore - from the support bottleneck that sparked the idea, through the proof of concept that validated it, to the hybrid architecture that bridges on-premises systems with AWS cloud services. This approach is relevant for enterprises struggling to scale AI Agents while maintaining enterprise grade governance and security standards.
